title.zh: 不同轨迹下人工确认回到起点的比例

caption.en: Share of videos rated 2 on return to the starting view. Every memory-equipped model drops sharply from out-and-back to one-way.
caption.zh: 人工评分为 2（明确回到起点画面）的视频占比。带记忆的模型在单向轨迹上均明显下降。

more.en: Single rater, not blind, question 1 only. Rated scene pairs per model: Real panorama control 4, HY-WorldPlay 19, Matrix-Game 3.0 19, SANA-WM 15, Matrix-Game 2.0 52. WorldCrafter-Fast is not yet rated in this pass.
more.zh: 单人非盲测评分，仅包含问题 1。各模型已评分场景对数：真实全景对照 4、HY-WorldPlay 19、Matrix-Game 3.0 19、SANA-WM 15、Matrix-Game 2.0 52。本轮尚未对 WorldCrafter-Fast 评分。

title.en: Mean arc score across models and trajectories
title.zh: 各模型在两种轨迹上的平均弧分数

caption.en: Mean SIFT arc score at departure threshold 0.15 across all generated scenes. WorldCrafter-Fast leads on one-way turns, followed by HY-WorldPlay.
caption.zh: 在离开阈值 0.15 下，所有已生成场景的平均 SIFT 弧分数。单向旋转中 WorldCrafter-Fast 最高，HY-WorldPlay 次之。

more.en: Computed on 640-pixel previews sampled every 2 frames (486 videos). WorldCrafter-Fast covers 32 of the 52 scenes. With the DINO aligner, one-way arc means are: Real panorama control 0.96, WorldCrafter-Fast 0.77, HY-WorldPlay 0.60, Matrix-Game 3.0 0.28, SANA-WM 0.17, Matrix-Game 2.0 0.11.
more.zh: 在 640 像素宽预览视频上每 2 帧采样计算（共 486 条）。WorldCrafter-Fast 覆盖 52 个场景中的 32 个。换用 DINO 对齐器时，单向弧分数均值依次为：真实全景对照 0.96、WorldCrafter-Fast 0.77、HY-WorldPlay 0.60、Matrix-Game 3.0 0.28、SANA-WM 0.17、Matrix-Game 2.0 0.11。

title.en: One-way point score versus arc score
title.zh: 单向轨迹上的点分数与弧分数对比

caption.en: Point score measures only the best revisit frame; arc score requires the approach before it to match. The gap is largest on WorldCrafter-Fast.
caption.zh: 点分数只看回访最好的单帧，弧分数则要求回归前的接近段也保持一致。两者在 WorldCrafter-Fast 上的差距最大。

more.en: SIFT aligner at departure threshold 0.15. In WorldCrafter-Fast one-way rollouts, 3 videos have arc below 0.6 times point; one has been inspected frame by frame and confirmed to jump abruptly to the remembered view.
more.zh: SIFT 对齐器，离开阈值 0.15。在 WorldCrafter-Fast 的单向视频中，有 3 条满足弧分数低于点分数的 0.6 倍；其中一条已逐帧核对，确认画面在接近起点时发生跳变。

title.en: Agreement with human ratings across departure thresholds
title.zh: 不同离开阈值下与人工评分的一致性

caption.en: AUC for separating rating 2 from 0 and 1, plus Spearman rank correlation on 218 rated videos. SIFT arc AUC is highest at 0.05 (0.972 vs 0.967 at 0.15), while Spearman peaks at 0.15 (0.793); both drop at 0.30.
caption.zh: 在 218 条已评分视频上区分 2 分与 0/1 分的 AUC 及 Spearman 秩相关。SIFT 弧分数 AUC 在 0.05 最高（0.972，0.15 处为 0.967），Spearman 秩相关在 0.15 最高（0.793），到 0.30 时均下降。

more.en: SIFT covers 218 rated videos; DINO covers 214. On the shared 214 videos at threshold 0.15, mean SIFT arc is 0.01 for rating 0, 0.07 for rating 1 and 0.73 for rating 2.
more.zh: SIFT 覆盖 218 条已评分视频，DINO 覆盖 214 条。在共同的 214 条视频、阈值 0.15 下，人工 0 / 1 / 2 分对应的 SIFT 弧分数均值分别为 0.01、0.07、0.73。

title.en: False closure rate on mismatched scenes
title.zh: 错配场景上的误回环率

caption.en: Share of videos whose confirmed overlap with another scene's first frame crosses the threshold. DINO triggers far more false matches than SIFT below 0.20.
caption.zh: 视频与另一场景第 0 帧的最大确认占比超过阈值的比例。在 0.20 以下，DINO 的误匹配率明显高于 SIFT。

more.en: SIFT covers 467 mismatched rollouts; DINO covers 107 rollouts, mostly HY-WorldPlay. Each video is paired with the next scene in alphabetical order, so a few consecutive real photos from the same location may inflate the tail.
more.zh: SIFT 覆盖 467 条错配视频，DINO 覆盖 107 条（主要为 HY-WorldPlay）。每条视频与按文件名排序的下一个场景配对，少量同地点的连续实拍照片可能抬高尾部比例。

title.en: Agreement with blind two-question human ratings
title.zh: 与盲测双问题人工评分的一致性

caption.en: Will compare point and arc scores against blind ratings on return and on approach consistency over the 60-video pilot package.
caption.zh: 将在 60 条视频的盲测包上，对比点分数与弧分数在“是否回到起点”和“回程是否连贯”两问上与人工评分的一致性。

more.en: Pilot-1 package of 60 anonymized videos covering all five models and real panoramas, with two 0/1/2 questions per video.
more.zh: 首批 60 条匿名视频盲测包，覆盖全部五个模型与真实全景，每条视频包含两个 0/1/2 分问题。
